text:
I found a plan that misses 2 (episode, follower) pairs and costs $97.43 (9743 cents). By my reasoning, 2 misses is the minimum, and this is the cheapest way to reach it.

```json
{"periods": [{"serviceId": "kestrel", "start": "2026-11-10"}, {"serviceId": "kestrel", "start": "2026-12-12"}, {"serviceId": "marquee", "start": "2026-12-28"}, {"serviceId": "lumen", "start": "2027-01-12"}, {"serviceId": "tidewell", "start": "2027-01-28"}, {"serviceId": "marquee", "start": "2027-02-12"}, {"serviceId": "tidewell", "start": "2027-02-28"}]}
```

**What gets missed**
- Priya misses The Distant Atlas episode 11 (Kestrel+, released 2027-01-16).
- Priya misses The Amber Archive episode 1 (Marquee, released 2026-12-08).
- Everything else is watched in time by every follower.

**Why the timeline is tight**
- In mid-January to mid-February, all four services have episodes due, but only 2 non-required services may be active at once.
- Lumen must run continuously from about January 12 to February 11 to cover all of The Quiet Harbor. Starting it later would cost Priya episode 1 instead.
- In the other slot, Tidewell must start by January 28. Its shows are followed by both Priya and Ines, so each missed episode costs 2 pairs.
- That leaves no room for Kestrel+ after January 11, so Distant Atlas episode 11 is lost.
- Marquee's first period cannot start by December 22 (for Amber Archive episode 1) and also run late enough to cover the late-January episodes. Late January is the bigger gap, so I gave up episode 1.
- Any arrangement that keeps both of these episodes ends up missing at least 3 others.

**Day-by-day access (never more than 2 services)**

| Dates | Active services |
|---|---|
| Nov 1–7 | Kestrel+ (already paid) + Marquee (already paid) |
| Nov 8–9 | Kestrel+ (already paid) |
| Nov 10–Dec 9 | Kestrel+ |
| Dec 10–11 | None |
| Dec 12–27 | Kestrel+ |
| Dec 28–Jan 11 | Kestrel+ + Marquee |
| Jan 12–27 | Lumen + Marquee |
| Jan 28–Feb 11 | Lumen + Tidewell |
| Feb 12–27 | Marquee + Tidewell |
| Feb 28–Mar 11 | Marquee + Tidewell |
| Mar 12–27 | Tidewell |

**Cost**
- Kestrel+: 2 × 1799 = 3598
- Marquee: 2 × 1399 = 2798
- Lumen: 1 × 1549 = 1549
- Tidewell: 2 × 899 = 1798
- **Total: 9743 cents**

Each service needs at least this many periods, because a one-month period covers only about 44 days of releases. Kestrel+, Marquee and Tidewell each have episodes spread over more than that, so dropping any period would add more misses.
